sources.consumed: Population calibration; whole-process independence with unrestricted route memory; deterministic Hankel minor test; sampling gap.
Centered versus raw moment definitions; G_l = D_r Gamma_l D_s; inherited target-rank conditions.

results.inputs: q=M=1; symmetric strict copy-refresh target with persistence 1/2; three independent stationary static error signs of common positive mean eta; whole-process mutual independence.
results.output: At eta=1/3 versus 2/3, observed finite or infinite trajectory laws have TV=1/4. Every common-gain estimator has maximal error probability at radius 1/6 at least 3/8.
results.not_claimed: Population nonidentifiability, or impossibility of all single-trajectory rank statistics.

results.inputs: Replace each static error by an independent stationary two-state retain/refresh Markov chain, refresh probability lambda>0.
results.output: Length-T observed-law TV at eta=1/3 versus 2/3 is at most 1/4+6(T-1)lambda. Taking lambda=1/(48 max(1,T-1)) gives maximal estimation error probability at least 5/16.
results.not_claimed: Failure of pointwise consistency for a fixed stationary ergodic instrument.

results.inputs: Two distinct independent whole error routes with positive coordinate gains; selected original target coordinates; Gamma_l=H A^l Sigma H^T.
results.output: K_G=(I_u tensor D_r) K_Gamma (I_w tensor D_s), hence equal rank at most M; a certified rho-minor proves hidden-coordinate count at least max(0,rho-q).
results.not_required: Gain calibration, a third route, a gain lower bound, invertibility of A, or positive definiteness of Sigma.

results.inputs: N iid replicas of the whole joint target-and-two-instrument window 0..L; L=u+w-2; q selected coordinates; N,u,w,alpha fixed in advance; Proposition 3 hypotheses.
results.entrywise_radius: delta=sqrt(2 log(2K/alpha)/N); centered cross-moment entry error at most 3 delta simultaneously with probability >=1-alpha.
results.certificate: An invertible empirical rho-minor Jhat with 3 rho delta ||inverse(Jhat)||_infinity < 1 certifies a nonzero corresponding population minor.
results.output: With probability >=1-alpha every certificate returned within the prescribed fixed block is correct: M>=rho and hidden>=max(0,rho-q).
results.adaptive_minor_selection: Allowed within the one fixed data set and prescribed block; no union bound over minors is needed.
results.limitations: Independent replica assumption includes fresh latent instrument histories. No optional-stopping guarantee, universal power/sample bound, actual-data validation, or floating-point implementation is supplied.

method_classification: Standard two-point testing, coupling, bounded-variable concentration, diagonal-rank invariance and Neumann perturbation applied to C34. No new general tool family or general novelty claim.
